## Stages workflow
- Work is organized in sequential stages
- each stage has parallel tasks
- each stage can only start once the previous stage taske are completed

Worker1.subtask: Build foundation and floor for WEST half of house. Place cobblestone foundation at Y=-60, then oak_planks floor at Y=-59. Cover area X=-420 to X=-418, Z=20 to Z=26.
Worker1.objective: Build the WEST half of the house
Worker1.fullPrompt:
You are Worker1, positioned at X=-420, Y=-60, Z=20. Do NOT move or navigate. Begin building immediately.

TASK: Build foundation and floor for WEST half of a 7x7 house.

COORDINATES:
- X range: -420 to -418 (3 blocks wide - your section)
- Z range: 20 to 26 (7 blocks deep)
- Y=-60: cobblestone foundation layer
- Y=-59: oak_planks floor layer

STEPS:
1. Place cobblestone at Y=-60 for X=-420 to -418, Z=20 to 26 (21 blocks)
2. Place oak_planks at Y=-59 for X=-420 to -418, Z=20 to 26 (21 blocks)

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT place any blocks at X=-417 or beyond (Worker2's area)
- Do NOT break existing blocks
- Do NOT move from your position
- Assume you have 64 cobblestone and 64 oak_planks

This is Stage 1 of 4. Worker2 is building the east foundation simultaneously.
constraints: Do NOT place blocks at or beyond X=-417
Do NOT break more than 20 sequential blocks
Worker2 is building east foundation simultaneously - do not interfere

TASK: Build WEST walls of house (4 blocks tall, Y=-58 to Y=-55).

WALL STRUCTURE:

- Oak_planks west wall: X=-420, Z=21 to 25, Y=-58 to -55 (leave door gap at Z=23)
- Oak_planks partial north wall: X=-419 to -418, Z=20, Y=-58 to -55
- Oak_planks partial south wall: X=-419 to -418, Z=26, Y=-58 to -55
- Glass_pane windows: Place at Y=-57 and Y=-56 in wall sections (2 per wall minimum)

DOOR OPENING:

- Do NOT break floor (Y=-59) or foundation (Y=-60)

Worker1.subtask: Build WEST roof slope. Oak_stairs sloping UP toward center ridge at X=-417. Start at X=-420, Y=-54, slope up to ridge at X=-417, Y=-53. Cover Z=20 to Z=26.
Worker1.objective: Build the WEST half of the house
Worker1.fullPrompt:
You are Worker1, positioned at X=-420, Y=-55, Z=20. Do NOT move or navigate. Begin building immediately.

TASK: Build WEST roof slope toward center ridge at X=-417, Y=-53.

ROOF STRUCTURE (sloped toward center):
- Row 1: oak_stairs at X=-420, Y=-54, Z=20 to 26, facing EAST
- Row 2: oak_stairs at X=-419, Y=-53, Z=20 to 26, facing EAST
- Row 3: oak_stairs at X=-418, Y=-53, Z=20 to 26, facing EAST (meets ridge level)

CENTER RIDGE: X=-417, Y=-53 (Worker2 will complete the ridge line)
Your stairs must ALIGN with this ridge - ensure Y=-53 at X=-418.

- RIDGE: oak_planks at X=-417, Y=-53, Z=20 to 26 (7 blocks - the center peak)

CENTER RIDGE COMPLETION:
You are responsible for placing the ridge line at X=-417, Y=-53.
Use oak_planks (not stairs) for a flat ridge peak.
Worker1's west slope will meet this ridge from the other side.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT place any blocks at X=-418 or below (Worker1's area)
- All stairs must face WEST (toward ridge at X=-417)
